_policy: RAM objects that hardware reads or writes on its own, so that a volatile qualifier on them is evidence, not steering, wherever tools/volatile_rom_proof.py shows the qualifier's effect on their accesses. An entry names the object (a data symbol, its mapped address and its size) and ROM code that programs a DMA channel with it: the code's bytes are pinned by SHA-256 and the transfer is read off the instructions at every run. Listing an object admits nothing by itself. ONLY the repository maintainer may add an entry; agents park the function and cite the evidence instead.
